subject: maths
question:
The following bar graph shows the production of cement (in lakh tonnes) of four companies-W, X, Y, and Z-over the years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f84f0aeab32a1781100a153d1bdd5e60c5ef2810094e617e22f886118d6f97d.png] 

The production of cement by company X in 2020 and production of cement by company Z in 2022 together is what percentage of the production by company W in 2021?
solution:
**Given:**

From the bar graph:

Production of cement by company X in 2020 = 30 lakh tonnes

Production of cement by company Z in 2022 = 25 lakh tonnes

Production of cement by company W in 2021 = 25 lakh tonnes

**Calculation:**

Production of company X in 2020 and company Z in 2022:

30 + 25 = 55 lakh tonnes

Required percentage = (55 / 25) × 100

⇒ Required percentage = 220%

**∴ The production of cement by company X in 2020 and company Z in 2022 together is 220% of the production by company W in 2021.**
